proves.claim: A prepared statement param {ref:n} or {json:obj, refs:{path:n}} binds statement n's inserted id, keeping JSON key order, and a ref to a later or missing statement is refused.

store.io-board-write-sequencer.plan-refs.why: A multi-row move must insert a parent and bind its id into later rows as plain data, because the sequencer takes no callback.

proves.claim: A prepared statement whose change count differs from its expect rolls the whole list back and refuses with PREPARED_WRITE_UNEXPECTED_CHANGES.

store.io-board-write-sequencer.plan-expe.why: A guard on change counts lets a prepared move detect a changed board and leave no partial write.
